claims.title: Physical nonlinear echoes, invariant actuator spaces and finite-Galerkin volume limits

quoted_fields.interface: Full physical Navier-Stokes with ordinary additive forcing on the unit three-torus, unknown mean-zero divergence-free H1 preparations and one force independent of initial state. The Fourier-line/planar invariant-space counterexamples are exact smooth nonlinear PDE solutions at zero disturbance. The selected second-variation calculation is the full projected INVISCID Euler equation near a prescribed shear, not a Fourier truncation. The volume theorem is for a FIXED finite real Fourier Galerkin system and does not transfer to the infinite PDE.
quoted_fields.failure: The full common-force/all-H1/all-Leray-Hopf existence question remains OPEN; there is no general finite-family negative. Invariant-space obstructions exclude only the named Fourier-line or planar-monochromatic families, not the general36-field family. The explicit second variation concerns one input w and requires smooth small-rho expansion; the small-impulse LOWER bound is inviscid and requires2pi|AT|<=1/4, while the large-impulse UPPER bound controls that selected coefficient only. Neither is a bound for the entire transformed bilinear operator, all Fourier pairs, higher nonlinear iterates or all weak trajectories. Fixed Galerkin volume bounds may vanish as dimension grows and are not PDE no-go results. Original scientific response/activity/prompt are preserved; model-throughout/helpers/compute remain unknown. No original ZIP identified and all source/access/transfer/resource holds persist.
